description: Relative day references that cross a month and a year boundary from a late-December anchor.
source: Composed for Stage 139 deliverable B7 date boundaries.
content: Dentist next Tuesday. Pay the propane bill on the 3rd. Inspection is a week from Friday.
notes: Anchored to Tuesday 2026-12-29 so every answer crosses both a month and a year boundary. 'Next Tuesday' from a Tuesday is the ambiguous one and is fixed by doctrine to the following week, 2027-01-05, not today. 'The 3rd' has already passed in the current month so it resolves forward to 2027-01-03. 'A week from Friday' is the Friday after this week's Friday 2027-01-01, so 2027-01-08. This is the fixture most likely to be fixed by the section A date-math tool call rather than by any prompt edit: slice 5a produced dates in 2020 from a 2026 anchor, which is arithmetic failure, not comprehension failure. The only fixture not anchored to 2026-06-12.
